headlines.text: That Sunday in 2025, a new champion was crowned for the AEW World Tag Team Titles as Brodido vs. The Hurt Syndicate vs. FTR battled it out, appearing on Forbidden Door, rated 6.71 ? ending the champion's reign at 7 defenses. For Brodido, it marked a first real shot at championship gold. Brodido stole a pinfall amid the chaos of a three-way, catching FTR off guard just as The Hurt Syndicate closed in to steal the win, crowning new AEW World Tag Team Champions.

On this day in 2022, United Empire vs. Death Triangle met in a Tournament Match, in the show-closing main event slot on Dynamite, rated 8.56 ? a genuine showstealer. A returning Kip Sabian's ringside interference on PAC proved decisive, letting Aussie Open finish off Rey Fenix and send United Empire through to face The Elite in the semifinals.
On this day in 2024, Top Flight & Rush didn't ease in ? their first AEW match was the main event as a team in a Ladder match, appearing on Collision, rated 6.89.

secondaries.text: Back on this day in 2025, Adam Page vs. MJF clashed for the AEW World Heavyweight Title, appearing on Forbidden Door, rated 8.06 ? a real highlight of the night. With a stipulation that a DQ or countout would cost him the belt, Page fought off MJF's every trick to retain the AEW World Championship.

Rewind to 2025, when the IWGP World Heavyweight Title was up for grabs as Zack Sabre Jr. vs. Nigel McGuinness went to war, appearing on Forbidden Door, rated 8.06 ? a genuinely great match. It was the first title opportunity of Nigel McGuinness's career. Sabre wrestled a clean technical showcase against McGuinness, retaining the IWGP World Heavyweight Championship in front of a hometown UK crowd.

2025 brought us this moment: Mercedes Mone vs. Alex Windsor vs. Bozilla vs. Persephone fought tooth and nail for the AEW TBS Title, appearing on Forbidden Door, rated 7.08 ? a good, competitive contest. For Bozilla and Persephone, it marked a first real shot at championship gold. Mercedes Mone was chasing gold for the 20th time. Mon? retained the TBS Championship in a four-way standout performance from newcomer Bozilla, ultimately catching Persephone in a hurricanrana for the pin.
